name: 77010 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77010 (Houston) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77010 (Houston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77010 (Houston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.2 times the typical level).
